description: Takes one optional hand slot as a parameter (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off hand), and a second parameter (0=default) if you would like the equipped item or any non-zero number for the currently rendered item, and returns the name of the item in the requested slot (defaulting to the main hand if no parameter is supplied) if there is one, otherwise returns ''. generated_doNotEdit.title: Get Equipped Item Name
generated_doNotEdit.description: DEPRECATED (Use query.is_item_name_any instead if possible so names can be changed later without breaking content.) Returns the name of the Item in the specified hand slot, or '' if empty. Takes two optional parameters: The first to specify hand slot (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off-hand. Defaults to main hand). The second parameter allows selecting the currently equipped item over the rendered item in a first-person context. These will only be different during item swap animations where the previously held item is still rendered while animating out.
